reserves.issuerOrObligor: Morpho Blue borrowers and Circle USDC

reserveReview.rationale: Morpho identifies USDC as the Smokehouse vault asset and the vault as a Steakhouse-curated lending product. The current live rows separate idle USDC from deployed Morpho positions; both retain the USDC wrapper dependency, while the deployed row carries borrower-credit, collateral, liquidity, and smart-contract risks.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current ERC-4626 live rows and Morpho Smokehouse USDC vault identity
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Both current adapter categories are classified; borrower-market allocations inside the deployed category remain dynamic.

providers.name: Smokehouse USDC MetaMorpho vault and Morpho Blue market contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Assets are held by identifiable noncustodial vault and market contracts, with idle and market allocations changing over time. Reuse is explicit because USDC is supplied to borrower markets. Contract-level isolation does not establish legal bankruptcy remoteness, and no static provider allocation is appropriate.
